## Frequently Asked Questions

(01)

### What stages do you invest in?

We focus on early-stage AI startups, typically writing initial checks of $1M-$10M at Seed and Series A. We're selective by design, making 8-10 investments annually to ensure meaningful support for each portfolio company.

(02)

### What is your geographic focus?

We specialize in the US-India corridor, with offices in Bangalore and Silicon Valley. We back founders building AI solutions for global markets or leveraging Indian talent while scaling internationally.

(03)

### How do you support portfolio companies?

Beyond capital, we provide hands-on operational support in product strategy, go-to-market planning, hiring, and scaling - areas where our experience as operators makes the greatest difference.

(04)

### What sectors do you focus on?

We exclusively invest in AI-native companies across horizontal applications, vertical solutions, healthcare, infrastructure, and consumer experiences. Our expertise is in AI, not specific industries.

(05)

### What makes Together Fund different?

Our operator DNA. Every partner has built and scaled successful companies before becoming investors. We understand the founder journey because we've lived it ourselves.
